a.lede: Dyson admits a component issue but won't say what's failing in its $500 toothbrush.
a.title: Dyson’s most overengineered gadget may have a waterproofing problem

b.lede: Despite admitting to a “component issue,” the company refuses to say what went wrong, how many units are affected in how many countries, and why it won’t recall its $500 AI toothbrush.
b.title: Dyson Won’t Say What’s Wrong With Its CameraJet Toothbrush
